name: Homemade Ice Cream
author: milutinke on based.cooking

ingredients.item: 2 handfuls blended blueberries (or any mix-in of your choice)

steps: Beat the condensed milk with a mixer for about 2 minutes until smooth. Set aside.
In a separate bowl, whip the heavy cream for about 4 minutes until thick and stiff peaks form.
Gently fold the condensed milk into the whipped cream. Add vanilla extract and blended blueberries, or your preferred mix-ins. Mix by hand until just combined.
Transfer to a clean 1 kg (approx. 35 oz) container. Spread evenly, press lightly to remove air pockets, and shake gently from side to side to level the surface.
Cover with plastic wrap, then secure with a lid. Freeze for 5-6 hours until firm.
PS: If you make your own condensed milk, add a pinch of salt, a pinch of baking soda, and 2 teaspoons of vanilla sugar.

culture.text: Homemade Ice Cream is the sixth album released by Tony Joe White, and the third he released for Warner Brothers. It was produced by White and Tom Dowd.
